The company demonstrates a healthy operational profile with strong profitability (EBIT margin of ~23.2%) and solid short-term liquidity (current ratio of 1.35x), alongside an equity cushion supporting 35% of total assets. However, total liabilities of $4,411M relative to EBIT of $336M indicate moderate leverage (Debt-to-EBITDA or Liabilities-to-EBIT implied around 13x total liabilities, though net debt is lower), which places its risk profile squarely within the solid investment-grade spectrum. Balancing the robust profit margins and capital base against the absolute scale of total liabilities yields an A- credit profile.

DECISION: A-
